files.summary: SiteDocument is a data layer class representing documents associated with a site, encapsulating SiteID and document ID. It is tightly integrated into HSPnet's Framework and Global Resources. Its main purpose is to facilitate the storage and retrieval of site-specific documents.
files.purpose: Manages site-related document information, enabling site document tracking and access within the system.
system_behavior: SiteDocument provides simple property access for document and site identification.

files.summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin implements a web page for staff administration in HSPnet, providing a filterable view of student employment applications. The page uses ASP.NET controls for input, validation, and display, with logic to refresh data based on date, site, and discipline selections.
files.purpose: Allows staff administrators to view, filter, and manage submitted student employment applications, providing workflow steps for filtering and validating data.

workflows.name: ViewSubmittedApplications
steps: Initialize with agency, site, discipline, and date filters.
Display last login info and personalized welcome.
Fill dropdowns for site and discipline selection.
Apply validators to date input fields.
Filter applications based on submitted and withdrawn status.
Bind filtered results to grid view with paginated display.
Provide hyperlinks for name and email actions.
Allow refresh and update of filter criteria.

business_rules: Withdrawn applications are indicated visually and filtered by checkbox.
validations: CustomValidator for ensuring StartDate is not after EndDate.
conditions: Show withdrawn applications if checkbox is checked.
system_behavior: RefreshData is called when filters change or page is initialized.
Grid view binds filtered applications and paginates results.
JavaScript variables setup for async operations and client validation.

files.summary: ServiceCode and ServiceCodes classes encapsulate service code metadata and retrieval. Service codes are categorized and localized, supporting retrieval by course, timetable, and through bulk queries. Used in contexts requiring service code assignment, filtering, and display.
files.purpose: Provides mechanisms to organize, localize, and retrieve service code records for other application modules.

workflows.name: RetrieveServiceCodes
steps: Invoke ServiceCodeListAll to fetch all service codes.
Invoke ServiceCodeASMOptionByCourseID or ServiceCodeASMOptionByTimetableID with relevant IDs.
Localize fields if alternative language mode is active.
Return structured list of service code entries.

business_rules: If UseAltLanguageFields is set, Name field uses NameAlt.
conditions: ServiceCode retrieval is based on course or timetable context.
system_behavior: ServiceCodes provides static methods for service code retrieval and localization.
